title: Lysogeny
description: Some phages do not burst their host at once: they write themselves into its genome and wait. A way to deliver genes. Unlocks cheap Recombinant DNA.

puzzle.goal: c cells are infected; a share f of them burst at once, each releasing B phages. Write how many new phages, P, come out.
puzzle.name: Phage count
puzzle.ask: Find P for c = @{c}, f = @{f} and B = @{B}.
puzzle.method: The rest wait in their hosts as prophages; only the share that goes lytic adds to the count.
